subject: Unable to publish shiny app due to error in setAccountInfo step of ShinyApps.io

messages.author: 22dd4f6914fac7f0
messages.subject: Unable to publish shiny app due to error in setAccountInfo step of ShinyApps.io
parts:
I am trying to use ShinyApps.io to publish web url for shiny project. 
Step to authorize account ( shinyapps::setAccountInfo) is failing with following error - 
Error in function (type, msg, asError = TRUE)  : 
  error setting certificate verify locations:
  CAfile: 
  CApath: 
Timing stopped at: 0.02 0 0.11 

I have checked permissions on shinyapps\cert directory and permissions seem ok. 
I need to get this working for Coursera assignment submission this Sunday so any help to resolve this is appreciated.
